app_fee.quote: A nonrefundable application fee of $60 (Master's), $80 (Doctoral), or $20 (Graduate Certificate Program) must accompany your application.

fee_waiver.value: The only fee waiver is for Florida Tech alumni returning for a graduate program, not for international applicants generally.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee will be waived for Florida Tech alumni who wish to return to their alma mater for a graduate program.

gre_general.value: The graduate school sets no single GRE rule; each program's table entry decides.

toefl_min.value: The university minimum is TOEFL iBT 4.0 on the new scale for tests taken on or after 1 January 2026.
toefl_min.quote: Test-takers on or after January 1, 2026, must earn a minimum score of 4.0

also.quote: with a minimum score of 80 for test-takers prior to January 1, 2026

ielts_min.value: The university minimum is an IELTS Academic overall band of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: an IELTS with an earned score of at least 6.5

english_waiver.value: India is not on the university's list of English-medium countries; an Indian English-medium degree counts only if the Office of Admission deems English the primary language of instruction.
english_waiver.quote: where English is the primary language of instruction as deemed at the discretion of the Office of Admission

notes: Entry test rules are from the English proficiency page. The graduate table lists GRE per program. Program pages carry no admissions facts beyond the shared funding sentence. Fall 2027 I-20 deadline is July 1, 2027. Chemistry, Ph.D. is listed among programs that start only in Fall.
